direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px/52px/1fr/56px, cols 184px/1fr/360px at 1366x768; FactoryStage >=55vw x >=60vh, Inspector internal-scroll only, DecisionBar pinned, no page scroll

colorTokens.stoppedRed: #E5484D only for stopped/offline CELL-MILL-2 outline, OFFLINE/STOPPED text and cross-hatch; owner-required exception to emerald/silver palette
colorTokens.logo: Immutable black/emerald/neon-green/brushed-silver asset, native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story; never recolor, crop, redraw or add elsewhere

direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection/panel; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions, preserves pattern+marker+text

components.Header: 48px; official logo left, live state centre-right, Lock recovery room as button
components.StepRail: 9 steps from single steps array, plus completion state; 36-40px icon+text+state buttons, completed/current/locked, aria-current=step; remove dead Workspaces disclosure
components.GuideStrip: 52px; Step X of 9, instruction + status only, no duplicate primary
components.FactoryStage: Focusable cinematic inline SVG 960x540 synced to inspector selection; dock/held lot, QA gate, conveyor, brushed-silver CELL-MILL-1/2, JOB-1001/1002 bays; every node keyboard-reachable, 2px #A8F04A focus outline offset 2px
components.EvidenceInspector: 360px; current task only, required action pinned, internal scroll only; pre-flight nonce/identity health as separate checklist from investigation evidence task; blocked prior tasks collapsed until replacements approved
components.Consent: Selecting a recovery option opens typed consent form in inspector; exact-phrase match enables acceptance, pinned while comparison scrolls internally, pending form survives read-only history
components.DecisionBar: 56px; Back left, human decision/status centre, one primary right; invalidating actions separated and text-labelled
components.Keyboard: Skip-to-stage first; header > rail > guide > SVG nodes > inspector > DecisionBar; arrows in rail/SVG, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite for results only

visualizations.FactorySVG: State-driven: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only, silver idle, neon feasible/accepted, red only stopped CELL-MILL-2, never route through offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 vs Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap; bidirectional SVG-inspector highlight
visualizations.Evidence: Persistent legend Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted, each pattern+marker+text, never colour-only; pending proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan coexist while replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the third logo in the inspector top-right; keep only required header and opening-story placements, replace with ACTIVE DISRUPTION micro-label.
Raise FactoryStage dominance: tighten top discrepancy tracks and bottom evidence strip so SVG machines scale up within 1366x768 without shrinking labels below 11px.
Make Inspect source evidence in inspector and DecisionBar one shared action/state; inspector link should focus/highlight ev-cert-qty and ev-recv-qty bidirectionally.
Separate route pre-flight (nonce/identity health, route availability) as its own labelled checklist above the investigation control; do not present it as part of the evidence investigation task.
Label the select as Investigation route with explicit Sample/offline consequence and disabled/live states; keep Run Sample investigation only in DecisionBar and remove implied duplication.
Add keyboard focus-visible styling to route select and FactoryStage nodes, with aria-live=polite announcing only the investigation result.
Keep consent pinned exactly as shown but add live character-match feedback (mismatch position, not just 27 remaining) while keeping Accept disabled until exact match.
Give each Select this path control full radio-group keyboard semantics (arrow keys, checked state) instead of three isolated buttons.
Truncated guide text must wrap or shorten to one status sentence; never ellipsis critical consent instruction at 1366px.
Strengthen untracked state: add UNTRACKED badge to board header count (3 proposed / 0 tracked) in tabular metrics, already in copy, so it survives scanning.
Show 40+30=70 allocation on the MAT-ALLOY-B route label in the SVG, tying proposal tasks to real quantities.
Make Decline proposal a text-labelled secondary in inspector, kept visually separated from Approve in DecisionBar to prevent accidental decline.
Pre-announce invalidation consequence adjacent to outage target select, not only in DecisionBar centre; include which accepted plan and 3 tracked tasks will be invalidated.
Render CELL-MILL-1/2 capacity as before/after bars (40h/$85, 24h/$90) so Apply second shock reads as capacity change, not just a dropdown.
Demote Start a fresh scenario (admin) to a separated, clearly destructive text button with confirmation, away from the outage controls.
Keep red strictly on CELL-MILL-2: verify Receiving outline uses silver/held pattern, not red, so stopped exception stays unambiguous.
Add before/after capacity delta (3 -> 2 feasible paths, CELL-MILL-2 24h -> OFFLINE) as tabular chips under the second-shock banner, bound to real state.
Repeat Step 2 separation here: pre-flight nonce/identity health checklist distinct from Reinvestigate recovery evidence action.
Constrained Split option overflows its card and collides with HUMAN DECISION heading; clamp reason text inside card and keep pinned consent fully visible without overlap.
State why substitute remains feasible while Split is constrained (requires two online compatible cells) directly on the constrained card, marker+text not colour-only.
Preserve exact-phrase disabled logic but add PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED chip inside consent header, matching DecisionBar status.
Expand Prior tracked work collapsed group affordance: show 3 BLOCKED count plus chevron/focus state; keep it collapsed while revised proposals await approval, as designed.
Add route guard in SVG: neon recovery flow must visibly terminate/bypass at offline CELL-MILL-2 and route only via CELL-MILL-1.
Unify t1-t3 due/dependency text to tabular 11/14 micro-labels so board fits without inspector scroll at 768px height.

DecisionBar primary says Verify ledger while inspector offers Verify ledger and Export independent checkpoint; make DecisionBar mirror the inspector's currently required action or label it as step-gate only.
Before/After panel is internally clipped (3 tracked tasks line cut); pin 70 / 35h / 48h metrics and let only narrative scroll internally.
Add passphrase strength/requirements checklist with text markers before typing, and keep Verify/Export disabled states explained, not colour-only.
Final state should replace Step X of 9 chrome with Recovery story complete consistently: rail shows checked completion, guide states PACKET SEALED with 18 events as one status sentence.
Make Review recovery proof in DecisionBar open the sealed packet summary (18 events, revised plan accepted) rather than implying a new primary task.
Masked passphrase field on completion should be read-only with custody note; remove editable affordance once packet is sealed.
